steps.text: Talk to Kangai Mau in the Brimhaven food store.
chat: 1. Ok, I will get it back.

steps.text: Travel to Ardougne (you can take a ship from Brimhaven to complete an easy Karamja Diary task), and head to the GPDT depot just south of the eastern bank.
Investigate the most north-eastern crate for the address label.
Use the label on the crate located 2 tiles to the south of the first crate.

chat: 1. So, when are you going to deliver this crate?

steps.text: Talk to Wizard Cromperty in the house north-east of the Ardougne market with the checkered floor., or if you have completed the medium or higher Ardougne diaries.
chat: 1. Yes, that sounds good. Teleport me!

steps.text: Go west 2 doors and enter the password KURT. If you click too quickly it will say "This combination is incorrect", try again slower.
Right-click Investigate the stairs, requiring 21 Thieving, then climb them.
Search the chest on the top floor for the totem. You must finish the dialogue.
